title: Retention Relief Clause on Earned Wage Access Renewal Dates — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Early Closure Terms
content:
**Relief clause.** An employer whose Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement is live and whose renewal date is at least the tier's minimum term, in whole months, after the enrolled date of its Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's, earns 20 percent relief on the early closure fee, an employer whose live agreement has an earlier renewal date earns 10 percent, and an employer with no live agreement earns no retention relief.

The agreement's status and renewal date — the date its current term ends and renews — are read from the employer's Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement record; the enrolled date and the tier are those of the disbursement service.

| Tier of the disbursement service | Minimum term (months) |
|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 0 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 0 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 12 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 12 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 12 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 24 |

| The employer's agreement | Retention relief |
|---|---|
| live, renewal date at least the minimum term in whole months after the service's enrolled date | 20 percent |
| live, earlier renewal date | 10 percent |
| no live agreement | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, a 12-month minimum term, service enrolled on the 10th of a month)

- Renewal date on the 10th, twelve calendar months later: 12 whole months, 20 percent.
- Renewal date on the 9th, twelve calendar months later: 11 whole months, 10 percent.
- Renewal date before the service's enrolled date: an earlier renewal date, 10 percent.
- An agreement in any status other than live: none.
